titleEn: A Problem for the Lion Demon

art.enemyPrompt: A full-body chibi sticker of a small sheet ghost stands on a flat magenta background, with a thick dark outline and no text. The pale blue-white body is a rounded dome with a flatter bottom, two dark oval eyes, a small open mouth, and two stubby side arms.
art.bossPrompt: A full-body chibi sticker of the Lion Demon King stands on a flat magenta background, with a thick dark outline and no text. He matches the ghost sprite as a larger pale blue-white rounded sheet with dark oval eyes, a small open mouth, stubby arms, and a short tawny lion mane, and he is not dressed as Sun Wukong.
art.backdropPrompt: A wide 16:9 children's storybook landscape for the generic theme and the title A Problem for the Lion Demon: a pale blue daytime sky with soft white clouds, warm ochre ground, and a quiet stone demon-hall courtyard kept to the far sides. A small cold clay stove and an empty meal bowl sit along the left verge, and a thin wisp of pale smoke drifts low along the right verge. A clear empty dirt path runs through the center, open and unoccupied. No characters, no animals, no letters, and no writing.
